% A guard: it checks a case that the fix of the files read with the
% primitive \input must not break.
% The same as test-priminput.tex, with the file read before
% \documentclass: \input test-priminput/glossary. There tex4ht.sty has
% not yet wrapped \@providesfile, and LaTeX's \@providesfile adds no name
% to \@filelist, so glossary.4ht is not read. As in the PDF, the file's
% text is in the page.
\input test-priminput/glossary
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
Early: \primglossary
\end{document}
